operators.name: custom_softmax
semantics: Computes softmax over the specified dimension dim of a 4D tensor.
Softmax formula: exp(x - max(x, dim=dim, keepdim=True)) / sum(exp(x - max(...)), dim=dim, keepdim=True).
The output has the same shape, strides, dtype, and device as the input.
For the given fixed input, dim=1 operates across the channel dimension with size 64.
No bias or scaling is applied by the softmax function itself.
Numerical stability: subtract maximum along the reduction dimension before exponentiation.
This operator will be implemented as a CUDA kernel in later stages.
First softmax along dimension 1 of the input tensor.
Input shape: [512, 64, 40, 40], dtype torch.float32, device cuda.
Output has same metadata as input.
Reduction across channels, preserving batch, height, width dimensions.
Second softmax along dimension 1 of the result of step_001.
Input shape: [512, 64, 40, 40], dtype torch.float32, device cuda.
Output has same metadata as input.
Return the tensor after two consecutive softmax operations.
